title: Being and Becoming: A Community for the Curious
description: A Toronto non-profit that builds a community around the philosophical exploration of ideas, questions and experiences, so that people can live more intentional, connected and meaningful lives. Its leadership, guests and audience come from many disciplines: artists, teachers, writers and philosophers.

events.title: Curiosity Café
events.text: every two weeks, a chosen topic explored together
